Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> looks downhearted after failing the quest.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 依頼の達成に失敗した<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は元気がないようだ。
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 委托失败的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>看起来无精打采。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 委託失敗的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>看起來無精打采。
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: Der Mut von <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ist nicht mehr zu sehen.
Data.UnitTalk_PRT: A sorte de <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> parece ter acabado.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: พลังชีวิตของ <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดูเหมือนจะหมดลงแล้ว
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: Tình trạng của <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> dường như đã kiệt sức.

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_KOR: 그럴 때도 있는 거지. 너무 상심하진 마.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ENG: It happens. Don't be too hard on yourself.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: そういう時もあるよ。あまり気を落とさないで。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_CHN: 总有这种时候的，别太沮丧。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_TWN: 總有這種時候的，別太沮喪。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_FRA: Ce n'est pas une illusion. Ne t'en fais pas trop.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_DEU: Das ist nicht so ungewöhnlich. Sei nicht so besorgt.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Incluso entonces, es una locura. No te sobreestimes.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_PRT: Até isso é mentira. Não me importo.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: แม้แต่ในยามนั้นก็ยังมีอยู่จริง อย่าได้สงสัยเลย
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_IND: Bahkan ada yang seperti itu. Jangan terlalu mengagumi.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Ngay cả khi có, đó cũng là điều không nên quá tự hào.

JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_JPN: 活力ポーションを渡す。
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_ESP: Le doy la poción de vitalidad.
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_THA: กำลังจะให้พลังชีวิต
JumpAnchorData.JumpAnchorStringId_VIE: Ta đang đưa một viên thuốc hồi phục.

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> decided to take some time to recharge.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は気分転換の時間を持つことにした。
Data.UnitTalk_FRA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> a pris le temps de se ressourcer.
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> hat die Zeit für die Wiedergeburt genommen.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: El <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ha decidido el momento de la reencarnación.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ได้ใช้เวลาในการฟื้นฟู
Data.UnitTalk_IND: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> telah menghabiskan waktu untuk mengisi ulang.
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã mang theo thời gian tái sinh.

Data.UnitTalk_ENG: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> turned away with a bitter look on her face.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は苦い顔を浮かべたまま背を向けた。
Data.UnitTalk_DEU: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> dreht sich um und zeigt ein gealtertes Gesicht.
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: El <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> se dio la vuelta con una cara triste.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> หันกลับมามองใบหน้าที่คุ้นเคย
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> quay lại với khuôn mặt bị làm mờ.

Data.UnitTalk_KOR: 다행히도 포션을 마신 <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>(은)는 기운을 되찾은 듯했다.
Data.UnitTalk_ENG: Thankfully, the potion seemed to have restored <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>'s energy.
Data.UnitTalk_JPN: 活力ポーションを飲んだ<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>は、元気を取り戻したようだ！
Data.UnitTalk_CHN: 幸好喝了药水的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎恢复了精神。
Data.UnitTalk_TWN: 幸好喝了藥水的<color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color>似乎恢復了精神。
Data.UnitTalk_ESP: Por suerte, el <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> recuperó su energía.
Data.UnitTalk_THA: โชคดีที่ได้ดื่มยาพิษแล้ว <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> ดูเหมือนกำลังฟื้นตัว
Data.UnitTalk_VIE: May mắn thay, <color=#F7BE45>[CHARACTER_NAME]</color> đã hồi phục lại sức mạnh.
